hero.title: PCOS Classification
hero.subtitle: Two tables, one target.
hero.tagline: A notebook that merges a PCOS clinical table with an infertility table, plots the features, and fits a logistic regression on a 30% holdout.
hero.impact: The target column is renamed from PCOS (Y/N). The model that actually fits is logistic regression. The other classifiers are imported and not trained.

problems.d: The clinical sheet and the infertility csv are merged on Patient File No. Repeated hormone columns from the infertility file are dropped.
AMH and the second beta-HCG column are coerced to numeric. Marriage years, that hormone, AMH, and fast food are filled with the column median.
A full correlation heatmap, then a second heatmap of features whose absolute correlation with the target is above 0.25.
train_test_split holds out 30%. LogisticRegression is fit, then train and test accuracy are printed as percents.

layers.title: Excel + CSV
layers.desc: PCOS_data_without_infertility.xlsx sheet Full_new, left-merged with PCOS_infertility.csv

layers.title: Types and nulls
layers.desc: Drop serial and file-number columns. Coerce two lab fields. Median fill on four columns

layers.title: Plots
layers.desc: Bar counts for yes/no clinical flags. Histograms for age, weight, and marriage years. Correlation heatmaps

layers.title: Logistic regression
layers.desc: All remaining columns except Target. 30% test. Printed train and test accuracy

highlights: Left merge on Patient File No.
Median fill for marriage years, beta-HCG, AMH, and fast food
Categorical bar charts and three histograms
Logistic regression with a 30% test split
